title: Clean Powder Brush II
descriptionHtml:
✓ Vegan✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Cruelty-Free

What it is: A tapered powder brush for precise applications and the ideal companion for powder blush, contour, highlight, and bronzer.

Brush Formulation: Powder


Brush Coverage: Buildable


Bristle Type: Synthetic


Ingredient Callouts: It is also gluten-free and cruelty-free.


What Else You Need to Know: Luxurious and durable, each brush is handmade in Kumano, Japan by the most prestigious brush maker in the world using cruelty-free, super soft nylon fibers and sustainably sourced birch. The high-performance fibers feel ultra-smooth with optimal density, softness, and function.

How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Swirl the brush in your compact to pick up product, tap once or twice, then sweep onto cheeks in a horizontal motion to gauge your desired effect.
-Powder glides on for a buildable and blotch-free finish. As always, start with a light-handed approach and build to your desired impact.
-Gently clean brush with mild soap and water.
-Gucci Westman’s tip: "Brushes are my most important tools. I think of them as an extension of myself, and it’s an absolute luxury to work with an extraordinary brush."
